title: Finish the Go port (api, store, jobs, tasks, remote, CLI), switch launchd templates to the Go binary, then delete the 359-file Python engine
notes: Python is deleted in the commit that makes the Go binary the one the templates start.

result: Finish the Go port (api, store, jobs, tasks, remote, CLI), switch launchd templates to the Go binary, then delete the 359-file Python engine
evidence: The Go binary implements the full CLI and all four LaunchAgents select it. Python sources, tests, packaging and CI were retired together. codeality-go gate, native and Linux CGO-disabled builds, launchd rendering and a round trip against a synthetic Python-created SQLite v10 store passed.
